implementation: Production Grammar compile, ParseSession and binding::analyze execute formal binding syntax, preserving lexical scopes, decoded Text spellings and original source spans.

Group, Scope, Bind, Reference, Visit, Import, Export, Propagate, Sequential and Recursive plans retain per-execution Entity identity and declaration-time visibility. Recursive headers are collected explicitly; independent foreign roots do not share namespaces implicitly.

Complete BindingAnalysis requires a closed FactSet. Invalid/Stopped preparation carries optional partial facts and complete source, map and Report closure. Global and Custom unsupported execution remains explicit in this slice.

Portable BindingReply uses language-neutral schemas, typed nested causes and validated source/fact/stage references. Real CBOR decoding into a fresh receiver and reencoding preserves values without granting native analysis proof to sender claims.

ViewError and SyntaxError expose actual nested resource stops while preserving ordinary semantic failures. Preparation commits complete Origin graphs, keeps active depth and sticky limits, and revalidates concrete package execution selection.
Iterative TypeDescriptor codec tests traverse 2048 alternating nested List/Option constructors through real CBOR and reject a 100000-level descriptor safely at a Depth limit of 64.
